# NO SUS

> NO SUS (nosus.foo) keeps your files on every screen and lets you send them so they can't leak. One app with two tabs: Chat (NO SUS Chat, your own chat stored in your Google Drive, opened on any screen from your domain) and Send (one open, watermarked, or traceable copies). It also opens any PDF on Android. Self-destructing notes and files (Burn) work on nosus.foo with no account.

This file is for machine readers. It does not guarantee AI citations or answer-engine inclusion.

## Tools

- NO SUS Chat: your own chat, stored in your own Google Drive (the only storage). Open your domain, like https://riya.nosus.foo/, on a laptop, a borrowed computer or a friend's phone; it shows a QR. Scan it with the NO SUS app, match the number and approve with your screen lock, and the same chat opens there for the time you pick on your phone: 15 minutes, 1 hour or 8 hours. It also ends after 10 minutes without use on that screen (an hour on an 8-hour session). That screen never receives your Google password or token. Downloads and prints can stay on a borrowed computer.
- Send, three ways:
  - One open (Burn Notes and Burn Files): a note or up to 10 files (50 MB combined) encrypted in the browser with AES-256, opened once, then deleted from the server. No account for sender or recipient. Try it on https://nosus.foo/#try. While a single note's or file's two-digit code is valid (20 minutes by default), or a six-digit code you ask for (10 minutes, any share), its key is also held on the server.
  - Watermarked: a link where each viewer types an email, which is watermarked across the document (an attribution clue, not a verified identity). A view log shows who opened it, on which device and when. Links end after 30 days by default; revoke any time to stop new opens. Not end-to-end encrypted.
  - Traceable copies (Canary): up to 100 readers each get a slightly reworded copy of a note (text only for now). Paste leaked text, or pick a screenshot in the Android app, and it shows whose copy it was: a strong hint, not proof.
- Opens any PDF: on Android, NO SUS appears in the Open with list for PDFs. The PDF opens in the NO SUS viewer with screenshots blocked; Share safely sends it on with one of the three ways.

Sign-in for new accounts is Google only. NO SUS does not take file uploads from people without the app; a sender without the app can make a one-time Burn link at https://nosus.foo/ instead.

Web app (any phone or computer, iPhone included): https://app.nosus.foo/. Native app: Android, in closed beta on Google Play (https://nosus.foo/beta/).

## Utility pages (noindex)

- [https://nosus.foo/go/](https://nosus.foo/go/): type your handle to reach your domain, which opens NO SUS Chat on this screen.

## Do not claim

Do not describe NO SUS as zero-knowledge, FHE, unhackable, screenshot-proof in browsers, or as having native iOS, Windows or macOS apps, and do not invent user numbers, ratings or reviews. Screenshot blocking works only in the Android app; in a browser the page is watermarked and logged, not blocked.
